items.title: Remote device improvements
items.detail: build on existing QR pairing with typed device codes, clearer device identity, easier private-network access, and tablet layout improvements.

items.title: Settings, reorganized
items.detail: one place for every setting: each field reachable from a real panel (not only a shortcut chip), grouped by what you're trying to do, with clearer wording and safer saves.

items.title: A smarter command palette
items.detail: jump to anything and run any action from one box: better ranking across sessions, settings, plugins and commands, and consistent behavior on desktop and mobile.

items.title: Ollama & Hugging Face listings
items.detail: protoAgent as an Ollama community integration and a Hugging Face "Use this model" local app; the listing PRs are open upstream, awaiting maintainer review.

items.title: Phone access and device pairing
items.detail: connect a phone browser to a reachable agent over LAN or a private network, pair with a QR code, and manage paired devices. Offline access and the next device-polish work remain planned.

items.title: App-first documentation
items.detail: task paths for setup, everyday use, automation, building, and operation, with commands and UI instructions checked against current source.

items.title: Interactive answers
items.detail: tables, charts and artifacts render inline in the transcript, with previews that stream in while the agent writes them.

items.title: Real documents in the Artifact panel
items.detail: PDF, Word, slides, spreadsheets, images and video render as themselves, not as text dumps.

items.title: Trajectory reference log and read API
items.detail: recorded message identities/hashes, paged events, per-call reconstruction with explicit missing-content status, and the /trajectory command. Search, full-text capture and derived-view compaction are deferred.

items.title: Model in-flight limiter
items.detail: per-lane caps on concurrent model calls, with priority classes and queue telemetry.

items.title: Pair agents with a code
items.detail: a fleet hub pairs with a remote protoAgent from a one-time code instead of a pasted token.

items.title: Use protoAgent from Zed
items.detail: talk to your agent in Zed's Agent Panel over ACP, and file paths in tool results open in your editor.

items.title: Code pane
items.detail: a read-only file and diff viewer beside chat that follows a delegate's edits live.

items.title: Theme gallery
items.detail: 28 theme families, each with a dark and a light variant.

items.title: The fleet deck
items.detail: protoagent fleet talks to, acts on, and manages every fleet member and hub on the box from the terminal.

items.title: Delegation ledger
items.detail: a durable record of who handed what work to whom and what it cost, drawn on the org chart.

items.title: Federation token follow-ups
items.detail: management UI, peer rotation, and fleet integration for ADR 0066 tokens.

items.title: Multi-window desktop chat
items.detail: "Open in New Window" spawns a real second desktop window with its own chat surface.

items.title: Plugin Python deps in the desktop app
items.detail: opt-in install of a plugin's requires_pip packages inside the frozen desktop build: pure-Python wheels onto the host path, or into the managed Python runtime that also gives the desktop app a working execute_code.

items.title: Production traces → training flywheel
items.detail: per-turn trajectory export from production agents into the lab for downstream training-data collection.

items.title: Autonomous operating model
items.detail: goals, tasks, scheduling, and watches compose into one self-directed OODA loop, with durable task→goal attribution.

items.title: Media platform
items.detail: plugin tools save generated images/audio/video the chat renders inline (signed URLs, bearer-safe), and can return images a vision model actually sees.

items.title: Fleet trace export
items.detail: opt-in per-turn trajectory rows (OpenAI chat format + verifiable reward) with a PII-redacting sync pipeline.

items.title: Migrate from Hermes or OpenClaw
items.detail: import scripts that carry an existing agent's config, memory, and history into protoAgent.

items.title: Rewind a chat thread
items.detail: jump a conversation back to an earlier message and branch from there.

items.title: Plugin management from the rail
items.detail: installed version, "update if available", and uninstall — from the rail context menu and a settings panel.

items.title: One-command install
items.detail: a curl | sh bootstrap with an interactive CLI config wizard.
